notes: Published title 'Smack That @#$% Up' is a masked crude phrase, so the page is titled Jake Rich DS; the published title stays in the source citation.
Posted 25 July 2001 with no Coruscant-set cards (the strategy says Coruscant is not out yet), so the format is Premiere - Tatooine.

Starting cards as posted under Starting (8): HDADTJ, Executor Holotheater, Executor Meditation Chamber, Visage of the Emperor, Prepared Defenses, Crush The Rebellion, Mobilization Points, Imperial Arrest Order; these count toward the total.
Visage Of The Emperor is posted once under Starting and once under Effects (2 total).

Posted 'HDADTJ' dested Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi; 'DVDLOTS' Darth Vader, Dark Lord Of The Sith; 'Mara Jade' Mara Jade, The Emperor's Hand; 'Dr. Ezvan and BOB' Dr. Evazan & Ponda Baba; 'Darth Maul' the Tatooine Darth Maul; 'Mau's Lightsaber' Maul's Lightsaber; 'Operation As Planned' Operational As Planned; 'Evader. Monnok' Evader & Monnok; 'Sebulbas Podracer (He Always Wins)' Sebulba's Podracer.

Posted 'Death Star Docking Bay' dested the Dark Death Star: Docking Bay 327; 'Could City Docking Bay' dested the Dark Cloud City docking bay, Cloud City: East Platform (Docking Bay) (the strategy calls the Death Star and Cloud City bays his two drainable docking bays).
No Escape is the Jabba's Palace Effect (the Reflections III shield came later).
The section headers add up to 60, but Characters (13) lists 14 cards, so the list totals 61 as published.
